# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide instructions in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

Before coding, read [docs/STATUS.md](../docs/STATUS.md), [docs/PROJECT_BRIEF.md](../docs/PROJECT_BRIEF.md), and [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Inspect current source before relying on documentation. Update the status and relevant contracts after material changes. Never report a test as passing unless it was run successfully.
